Author: @KatieNT
Comment:
Totally snagging a huge chunk of Gen X there, babe!
Gen X : 1965 - 1980
Millennial : 1980 - 1995
Gen Z : 1995 - 2010~2013

Edit, since this needs to be explained:
Generations vary by 1 or 2 years, depending on where you're looking, where you're from, and what you experienced growing up. Yes, there are 1 year overlaps in the years I listed, these are the most common that I've come across for a while now.
Trends, media, events, inventions, advancements, etc have a significant role in the variation. What we grew up with and what we were exposed to are a huge factor in determining where we fall if we're near a cusp point (end of one, start of another). For example; you'll find early trend use for a 1995 person often placing them in Z rather than Millennial, or later trend adoption for a 1980 individual leading to a higher relation to Gen X. This overlap is also where "xennial" (77-83) and "zillenial" (93-98) come from, micro generations made of cusp years based on varying relatability to more than one generation.
